Jeffrey! Awesome job on the show. I really enjoyed it! It’s nice to hear someone question some of the ideas that fly around in our ivory towers, so to speak. You seem to speak from true experience. Outstanding.

Brendan
Jeff, great job on the show! If anyone is just wanting to hear the part of the show you are involved in (i.e. skip the beginning), you are introduced 12mins and 50sec into the show.
